Place a local copy of p5.js here to run without any network/CDN access.

Recommended file name: p5.min.js
Version tested: 1.9.0

Download options:
- From cdnjs: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.9.0/p5.min.js
- From unpkg: https://unpkg.com/p5@1.9.0/lib/p5.min.js

Once added, JS/loader.js will load this local file first and skip CDNs.
